methodologyNotes: Roster of 12 models. Two task-specified models had no current US match and were replaced with the closest verifiable equivalents: (1) InSinkErator Evolution 100 (1/2 HP) is a UK/international designation; (2) Moen GXP75C does not exist — the GXP (Prep PRO) line tops out at 1/2 HP (GXP50C); the real Moen 3/4 HP continuous-feed model is GXS75C (Host Series), which is used here. Sources: official manufacturer pages (insinkerator.com, wasteking.com, moen.com, shop.moen.com, geappliances.com), major retailers (Home Depot, Lowe's, Amazon), and independent reviews (shouldit.com, garbagewastedisposal.com). Prices are lowest verified published US retail/MSRP on-page; discontinued models noted in provenance with last-known retail. sound_insulation = any manufacturer-claimed noise treatment beyond bare motor housing; septic_safe per manufacturer claim. Adversarial corrections applied: Badger 500 sound_insulation true->false (official page documents no Quiet Collar / noise treatment; spec-identical to Badger 5); GE GFC525N rpm 2800->null (no single reliable value — GE omits RPM, sources range 2300-4363); GE GFC525N septic_safe null->true (Lowe's lists it as Septic Safe). accessedAt 2026-06-20.
